entities.name: Maliha
entities.description: A healer who was attacked by Arzuna and rescued by Grace.
entities.quote: Maliha lifts a trembling hand, forming a small shimmer of healing light. It fizzles.

entities.name: Arzuna
entities.description: A powerful, vengeful individual who feels abandoned by Grace and seeks to punish her.
entities.quote: She rushes again, faster than the eye can follow — knee to ribs, elbow to jaw

entities.name: Grace
entities.description: A powerful being who wields energy and possesses the golden Locket of Aldercrest.
entities.quote: The LOCKET OF ALDERCREST ignites—light bursting through the rain. Her blindfold burns away. The LEFT EYE snaps open—GOLD, radiant and alive.

timeline_events.title: The Night of the Golden Eye
timeline_events.description: Grace confronts Arzuna on a mall rooftop to rescue Maliha, unleashing her full power.
timeline_events.quote: Grace bursts through the exit door—breathless, soaked, eyes wide. Across the rooftop, ARZUNA crouches over MALIHA, whose body lies limp in a puddle of rain and blood.
